itemListElement.name: Read AI vs Otter AI in 2026: How These Note Takers Compare for US Teams

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI or Otter AI better for meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: For live transcription and lower cost, Otter is better; for engagement analytics and coaching, Read AI. One practical tiebreaker: Otter Business lets a user join 3 concurrent meetings, while Read AI counts 30 measured video conferences a month on every plan, including Enterprise+. Heavy double-booking favours Otter.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Otter AI and Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter AI centres on live, searchable transcripts; Read AI centres on meeting reports with talk time, filler words, bias and charisma scores. One difference buyers miss: Read AI keeps unlimited storage on every paid plan, while Otter meters imported files at 300, 1,200 and 6,000 minutes a month by tier.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI cheaper than Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Read AI Pro costs $15 a month billed yearly versus $8.33 for Otter Pro, and $19.75 against $16.99 monthly. Watch the workspace caps, though: Otter Pro bills at most 5 users and Business 25, so a 40-person rollout on Otter means Enterprise, which is quote-only.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI show a live transcript like Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, partly: Read AI shows live notes and metrics in-meeting, 5 sessions a month on Free. Otter runs live transcription on every plan and adds integrated live captions for Zoom and Google Meet. For RTMP-based live transcription, Otter charges additional fees, which is worth checking before a big event.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for Microsoft Teams, Read AI or Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both join Teams calls. Read AI goes one step further with an AppSource app you install from the Teams store, which lets you add its assistant to a call by pasting the join URL. Otter answers Teams differently: video replay covers Zoom and Google Meet only. See our guide to an AI note taker for Microsoft Teams.

mainEntity.name: Do Read AI and Otter support languages other than English?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, within limits. Read AI says meeting reports come in 16+ languages, Hindi included, though its plan card claims 20+. Otter's own feature table names 6: English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Chinese. Lynkk covers 17 plus auto-detect and a Hinglish setting.
